text:
incidents-bot: P1 paging: Observed increased 5xx rate for the Redwood API in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 starting ~09:12 UTC. Route-level errors affecting streaming responses. Auto-escalated to on-call.

alex_sre: taking this. quick check: is it all models or specific routes? seeing spikes on /v1/generate and /v1/stream.

marta_support: customers in EU reporting timeouts, support queue filling with similar stack traces. We should plan a coordinated status update — need localized messages for EU/UK/FR/DE and APAC JA/ZH.

oncall_rotation: handoff note: I'm primary for the next 45m, will coordinate mitigation. If we need infra-scale, loop in eu-sre.

eu_sre: I'm on tools. Initial hypothesis: a node pool in eu-west-1 hit a scheduling glitch after a recent kernel patch; degraded throughput + retry storms from SDKs causing KV cache thrash. Scaling to extra pods now.

loren_commops: drafting status page copy now. we should stagger customer notices per region based on local business hours and timezones. Proposed windows:
- Americas: 13:30-14:00 UTC (08:30-09:00 ET)
- Europe: 09:30-10:00 UTC (10:30-11:00 CET)
- APAC: 00:00-01:00 UTC (09:00-10:00 JST) — but APAC prefers earlier morning local times; asking apac_support for preference.

apac_support: for Japan/KR we prefer 09:00-10:00 local; for ANZ, 10:00-11:00 local. We can send a short initial blurb immediately and schedule follow-ups at local business hours.

alex_sre: mitigation steps: 1) scale eu-west node group by +30% (in progress), 2) enable read-fallback to replica model pool for streaming routes, 3) temporarily increase request timeout & reduce max concurrency on affected pods to limit retry storms.

incidents-bot: Automation note: scheduled status update job created: job_id=job_20240411_42, next_run=1718001600 (2024-04-11T09:40:00Z). Will post update to #status-page and send region-specific email digests if copy provided.

loren_commops: paste below are the localized blurbs I'm proposing. keep them short — we should avoid technical verbs for customer-facing messages; have translations (quick pass) for status page + email subject lines. Please review edits.

--- English (US)
Subject: Service disruption impacting streaming responses — Redwood Inference
Blurb: We’re investigating higher error rates affecting streaming and generation in some regions. Our engineers are working to restore full service. We’ll post updates here and on our status page.

--- Français (FR)
Objet: Interruption de service affectant les réponses en streaming — Redwood Inference
Texte: Nous enquêtons sur une augmentation des erreurs affectant la génération et le streaming dans certaines régions. Nos ingénieurs travaillent à rétablir le service complet. Nous publierons des mises à jour ici et sur notre page de statut.

--- 日本語 (JP)
件名: ストリーミング応答に影響するサービス障害について — Redwood Inference
本文: 一部リージョンで発生しているストリーミングおよび生成機能のエラー増加について調査中です。エンジニアが復旧作業を進めています。最新情報は当ページおよびステータスページでお知らせします。

--- 中文 (简体)
主题: 影响流式响应的服务中断 — Redwood Inference
正文: 我们正在调查在部分地区影响流式和生成的较高错误率。我们的工程师正在努力恢复全部服务。我们将在此处和状态页面发布更新。

loren_commops: internal comms templates too (for account execs & CSMs):
- short Slack DM template: "Heads-up: We're investigating streaming errors in <region>. We'll update ASAP. Link: <status.url>"
- longer email template for large customers: Subject and Blurb + estimated ETA once confirmed.

marta_support: approve translations for FR/EN. Quick ask: can we include a small FAQ line for customers who use dedicated/private deployments? e.g., "If you run Redwood Dedicated or Private, contact your account rep for region-specific impact."

loren_commops: added that line to templates.

alex_sre: update — autoscaling finished, error rate dropped ~40% over the last 6m. Still seeing retries from older SDK clients. I'm going to roll a short config tweak to reduce connection keepalive on streaming frontends.

incidents-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai: incident=INC-2024-042, severity=degraded, affected_regions=[eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1], update_ts=1718002200. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-042

loren_commops: scheduling regional sends:
- EU: immediate post + email 09:45 UTC (local business hour window)
- US: initial internal notice now, customer-facing email at 13:30 UTC
- APAC: initial short blurb now (localized) + full email targeted at 23:00 UTC (JST morning recipients will see it at ~08:00 local).

apac_support: confirm APAC timing ok. we'll queue translations for ZH and EN-AU variants.

alex_sre: mitigation complete for now. I recommend we keep the status as "degraded" until 2 consecutive 5m windows show normal error rates. I'll post again once stable.

loren_commops: internal postmortem comms checklist (for when we close):
- timeline of events with UTC timestamps (include psuedo-local times for major customers)
- exact customer-facing messages + translations used and send timestamps
- lessons learned re: localized scheduling (what worked, what to change)
- follow-up action for SDK team to add client-side exponential backoff guidance to docs

marta_support: noted. i'll track impacted customer list and send targeted follow-ups to top-20 accounts once we have final postmortem.

incidents-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 1718002800 (2024-04-11T10:20:00Z). Current owner: alex_sre -> next:oncall_rotation.

oncall_rotation: thanks. I'll join the call in 10. will also help coordinate APAC follow-ups for local partners.

alex_sre: final update: error rates back to baseline at 1718004800. marking mitigation as successful. recommend we send a final status update and localized 'incident resolved' blurb around 1718005400 after we verify stability for 1h.

loren_commops: final localized resolved blurbs (short):
EN: The service disruption affecting streaming responses in some regions has been resolved. We’re monitoring.
FR: La panne affectant les réponses en streaming dans certaines régions est résolue. Nous surveillons.
JP: 一部リージョンで発生していたストリーミング応答の障害は解消されました。現在も監視中です。
ZH: 已解决影响部分地区的流式响应的服务中断。我们正在继续监控。

marta_support: thanks everyone. I'll prepare targeted customer emails for the impacted accounts and include translations.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2024-042: status changed to "resolved" at 1718004920. Closing thread.
